descriptions.AVAILABILITY_FACTOR: fraction of nameplate a unit offers by default (the rest is derated headroom / self-scheduling reserve).
descriptions.BACKSTOP_PRICE_MULT: import backstop is priced at this multiple of the zone gas SRMC — above every domestic tranche, so it binds only near the cap.
descriptions.BACKSTOP_WEEKS: import backstop capability = demonstrated import headroom over this trailing same-weekday window (weeks).
descriptions.DEEP_SURPLUS_FLOOR_EUR: price floor (€/MWh) of the deepest must-run / RES block in a solar-surplus regime hour, so the coupled clear can genuinely fall below zero.
descriptions.DEMAND_ELASTIC_PRICE: price (€/MWh) above which the elastic demand tail curtails.
descriptions.DEMAND_ELASTIC_SHARE: fraction of demand bid elastically (price-sensitive) rather than firm at the cap.
descriptions.DERATE_HEADROOM: headroom multiplier on the fleet-truthing derate target (do not derate below trailing p95 × this).
descriptions.FLEET_COMPLETION: complete the offered fleet up to the demonstrated p95/installed truth target (fills structurally-undersized unit registries).
descriptions.FLEET_TRUTHING: derate baseload types to their demonstrated trailing capability (crisis-year honesty).
descriptions.MUST_RUN_PRICE_FACTOR: the deepest must-run block is bid at this fraction of the unit's SRMC — below cost by design (restart cost exceeds running below cost).
descriptions.MUST_RUN_SRMC_THRESHOLD: a unit is committed (must-run) when its SRMC is below this multiple of the zone's gas SRMC.
descriptions.NUCLEAR_AVAIL_FLOOR: nuclear availability at/below which the opportunity premium saturates (crisis floor).
descriptions.NUCLEAR_AVAIL_REF: nuclear availability at/above which no opportunity premium applies.
descriptions.PEAK_EXPONENT: exponent of the peak-hour scarcity markup (normalized-demand^n) — flat off-peak, steep at the day's demand peak.
descriptions.PRICE_CAP: bid price cap (€/MWh) — firm demand and scheduled exports bid here.
descriptions.TRANCHES: SRMC tranches (share of p_max, price multiplier), cheapest first — how one unit's offered capacity is sliced and priced above/below its cost.
descriptions.WATER_VALUE_DRY_BOOST: multiplier applied to the reservoir water value in a dry year.

BACKSTOP_PRICE_MULT.source: import-backstop price multiple of gas SRMC, named form

DEMAND_ELASTIC_PRICE.source: elastic demand curtailment price, named form

DERATE_HEADROOM.source: headroom on the derate target, named form

FLEET_COMPLETION.source: structural switch: complete undersized fleets to demonstrated capability

FLEET_TRUTHING.source: structural switch: derate baseload to demonstrated capability

MUST_RUN_SRMC_THRESHOLD.source: commitment threshold as a multiple of gas SRMC, named form

NUCLEAR_AVAIL_FLOOR.source: nuclear premium-saturation availability floor, named form

NUCLEAR_AVAIL_REF.source: nuclear no-premium availability reference, named form

PEAK_EXPONENT.source: peak-hour scarcity markup exponent, named form

TRANCHES.source: named bidding form (share, multiplier per tranche), OOS-validated

anchor_share.source: fraction of the coupled reference the anchored fleet asks for, OOS-validated

backstop_scarcity_credit.source: structural switch: also credit that headroom in the scarcity margin

boundary_book.source: structural choice: model an out-of-footprint neighbour as an elastic counterparty

boundary_capability.source: trailing-366d p95 gross observed flow per 4h block over the boundary border

eua.source: EUA carbon close, last trading day strictly before the market date (yfinance.eua_co2)

fleet_p95_installed.source: trailing ENTSO-E per-type output p95 / registry installed capacity (fleet completion + truthing)

fleet_truth_mode.source: structural choice: true the fleet to p95 or to installed capacity

flow_climatology.source: ex-ante cross-border flow rule (load-analogue median + D-2 observed), :v3

hydro_model.source: structural choice: gas-anchored vs reservoir-opportunity water value

import_backstop.source: structural switch: offer demonstrated import headroom as elastic supply

import_backstop_qty.source: trailing-8-same-weekday demonstrated import headroom beyond the endogenous ATC

nuclear_avail_share_hi.source: anchor share at full nuclear availability, OOS-validated

nuclear_avail_share_lo.source: anchor share at the nuclear crisis floor, OOS-validated

nuclear_bid_ref_ceiling.source: cap on anchor-lifted nuclear bids (× reference), OOS-validated

nuclear_srmc_floor.source: France off-peak nuclear bid floor, OOS-validated

opportunity_anchor.source: structural choice: which fleet re-bids against the coupled price

ref_priced_exports.source: structural switch: price retained-border exports at the coupled reference

reservoir_dryness.source: reservoir shortfall vs the same ISO week in prior years (ENTSO-E)

reservoir_fill.source: weekly reservoir fill ratio vs the trailing-52-week maximum (ENTSO-E)

scarcity_import_credit.source: structural switch: credit available import capacity against the scarcity margin

seasonal_drawdown.source: structural switch: follow the seasonal reservoir drawdown cycle (Swedish north)

ttf.source: TTF front-month gas close, last trading day strictly before the market date (yfinance.ttf_f)

water_value_base.source: per-region reservoir opportunity cost (× gas SRMC), OOS-validated

strategy_glossary.boundary_export: out-of-footprint neighbour export demand over the border's demonstrated capability (firm base slice + elastic tail)
strategy_glossary.boundary_import: out-of-footprint neighbour import supply, laddered on the neighbour's own fundamental SRMC over the border's demonstrated capability
strategy_glossary.demand_elastic: price-sensitive demand tail (curtails above the elastic bid price)
strategy_glossary.demand_firm: inelastic demand at the price cap (must-serve load)
strategy_glossary.export_demand: net scheduled exports taken as firm demand at the price cap
strategy_glossary.extra: scenario order added via the extra_orders hook
strategy_glossary.import_backstop: ex-ante elastic import headroom beyond the endogenous ATC, priced above every domestic tranche (binds only near the cap)
strategy_glossary.import_fixed: net scheduled imports injected as price-taking supply
strategy_glossary.must_run_deep: must-run deepest block: technical minimum offered near €0 (5% of SRMC) — shutting down and restarting costs more than running below cost
strategy_glossary.must_run_rest: must-run remainder: the rest of minimum load bid below SRMC (start-up cost amortised over the committed hours)
strategy_glossary.peak_tranche: peak tranche: upper capacity priced above cost for scarcity margin + peak-hour strategic bidding
strategy_glossary.ref_priced_export: net export re-priced at the coupled reference so the exporter curtails under domestic stress
strategy_glossary.res_forecast: renewable forecast offered as price-taker (support schemes make output price-insensitive; floored negative in a solar-surplus regime)
strategy_glossary.srmc_base: base tranche at short-run marginal cost: fuel/efficiency + CO₂ + O&M, no scarcity markup
strategy_glossary.strategist: order produced by the strategist hook (replaces the source ladder)
strategy_glossary.water_value_anchored: hydro water value: export opportunity cost = the coupled reference price (two-pass anchor)
strategy_glossary.water_value_gas_anchored: hydro water value: reservoir opportunity cost anchored to gas SRMC (premium at peak, boosted when dry)
strategy_glossary.water_value_reservoir: hydro water value: shadow price of stored water — near-free when reservoirs are full, rising to the thermal alternative as they empty
